idea-plugin.name: LeetCode Break
idea-plugin.description:
Practice LeetCode in your IDE with recommendations based on your project's code.

  • Use the official LeetCode China or international website in an embedded browser to read, run, and submit solutions.
  • Synchronize real problems, difficulty, topic tags, premium indicators, and accepted status through your website session.
  • Find relevant problems using local source analysis, with file and line references explaining each recommendation.
  • Filter by difficulty, estimated practice time, title, problem ID, or topic.
  • Keep authentication cookies in IntelliJ Password Safe. Project source code is never uploaded.

Requires IntelliJ Platform 2026.2 and a JetBrains Runtime with JCEF. Website verification and premium access remain controlled by LeetCode. The website API may change. Practice times are estimates.

Free and open source under the MIT license. This is an independent plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by LeetCode.

Source code and documentation · Issue tracker

在开发间隙使用内嵌 LeetCode 官网刷题，支持力扣中国站和国际站。分页同步真实题库与官方通过状态， 本地分析项目知识点并提供附文件行号的推荐；登录会话保存在 IDE Password Safe，源码不上传。 题目、编辑器、运行与提交均由官网提供。采用 MIT 许可证，免费开源，非 LeetCode 官方插件。
